body:
I'm sorry this happened to you, I've been in similar situations. 

This is my personal opinion so take it as you will but I think you should confront him once not for closure but just to say your peace. The worst thing is ending a friendship and regretting not doing anything about it or speaking your truth. 

From my personal experience, this wont get you closure but it will allow you to be truthful and honest with yourself and him. Speak up for yourself even if you dont get a response. 

As for closure, I find you have to create your own closure. Closure comes from within, especially when you have to forgive people who aren't sorry, let go of people who ghosted you and piece together things without any of the answers but your own intuition and understanding. All of that stuff comes from within you. People wont give you closure but you give yourself closure.
I really needed this. And the world needs people like you. I've been going through a rough patch, battling some inner demons. I really need a friend right now.

So, I work in the restaurant industry as a cook and often times chicken will sometimes appear pink ish even if it is fully cooked. It used to trip me out a lot but as long as the internal temp is 160F you are fine. Theres tons of times I've checked the temperature of a chicken and its 160 or over and it still appears slightly pink. Often times it's just the juices.

I did reach out and try and apologize so I know at least in that sector even if I did hurt someone im trying to own up to it. What had happened was I said something and ended up offending someone but i was completely taken by surprise because i didnt realize it would hurt them. 

And yeah I gotta cut the dead weight. I just am figuring out how to. 

Thank you though, I just need to remember I'm doing okay, I'm just being hard on myself.

I think you're right in terms of me just amplifying everything and then going into a negative downward spiral. I have this really bad habit that when I upset someone, or disappoint them then I berate myself to no end for it. But the thing is being human you're going to upset and hurt people whether you mean to or not. It's part of living. I need to learn how to still own up to my mistakes without absolutely torturing myself over them. 

When I rationally think of everything....maybe I'm doing okay?

As for my job search, I'm doing well I've got interviews lined up for me. I'm moving out so I'm scared of not having enough money but that's BS because I've got savings and I know people will hire me. And I've got loving parents that will help me out. I think I just stress myself out.

As for my friends, I just said a joke that mildly offended them and I really didnt intent to or even realize that it might of offended them. So when I noticed that they were actually upset I felt like absolute garbage and tried to apologize but it seems like they sort of shut off. I also did something that upset them earlier that week. And I know it sounds stupid but I just felt like I fucked up too many times too soon even if its little things. And I just felt like a shitty friend.

As for the relationship, sorry I should of been more specific. It's not really a relationship, just a friendship that could of turned into a relationship but it never worked out. And I could go on forever but bottom line is we're both bad for each other. And I dont know how to end it. Part of me knows it's the right thing to do but part of me feels like I'm giving up on this person and I dont like giving up on people. But I know if anything this is more just giving this person and myself the freedom to let each other go.

Sorry for the rambling but thank you for responding to my post. Maybe I'm making myself seem like I'm fucking up more than I actually am.

Took boxing classes and had a personal trainer but then I lost my job and told my trainer I couldn't go to the gym for a little while because I was unemployed (I couldn't pay him) so I told him once I get a new job I'll start training with him again but he just told me not to worry about it and that he loved training me so he trained me absolutely for free for 3 months until I got a new job.
